summary: Aikenhead's Hardware was a Canadian chain of hardware stores serving Greater Toronto, Southern Ontario and northern Ontario. The note traces its origin to the original Toronto store, founded in 1830 as Ridout's Hardware Store by Joseph Ridout at King Street and Yonge Street.
one_line: Aikenhead's Hardware was a Canadian hardware store chain in Ontario, originating as Ridout's Hardware Store in Toronto in 1830.
key_facts: Aikenhead's Hardware was a chain of Canadian hardware stores.
The chain was located in Greater Toronto, Southern Ontario and northern Ontario.
The original store was founded in Toronto in 1830.
The original store was named "Ridout's Hardware Store".
Joseph Ridout founded the original Ridout's Hardware Store in Toronto in 1830.
The original store was located on the corner of King Street and Yonge Street in Toronto.
